question: MTP×4 投机解码在 V100 上的实际加速比受限于 Draft 模型的生成速度与 Target 模型的验证速度耦合；假设 Draft 模型为 7B 级别，其在 V100 上的生成速度约为 100-150 tokens/s，而 Target 27B 验证 4 个候选 token 的计算量相当于 4 次 Prefill (短序列)，耗时约为 4 * (27GB/3600GB/s) ≈ 30 ms；若接受率 α=0.7，有效生成速度 Speed_eff = (1 + 3α) * V_target / (1 + T_draft_overhead)，其中 V_target 为基础 Decode 速度，计算得 Speed_eff ≈ 3.1 * 40 tokens/s / 1.2 ≈ 103 tokens/s，相比基线 40 tokens/s 提升约 2.5x。

sources.title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
sources.snippet: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model.
